类 RuleBasedSkillScoringProvider

java.lang.Object
RuleBasedSkillScoringProvider
所有已实现的接口:
SkillScoringProvider
public class RuleBasedSkillScoringProvider extends Object implements SkillScoringProvider
Default offline scorer used by the demo when no external model is configured.

It wraps the token-based MatchingService result and labels the output clearly so the user can see that the recommendation came from local explainable logic.
